messages:
leah (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: headcount and the team map. dropping answers here. please keep questions short.
kevin (CEO): key point: we are shifting hiring into infra, runtime, and enterprise reliability for the next 2 quarters.
tara (Head of Eng): team consolidation: 15 teams -> 12 squads. this is about tighter ownership, not cuts.
yuri (SWE): will sprint commitments change because of the consolidation?
tara (Head of Eng): minimal change. owners will hand off components over 2 sprint cycles.
omar (SRE): are SRE hires prioritized? we have a couple of oncall gaps.
kevin (CEO): yes, SRE and infra get priority approvals. get reqs in with the "priority" flag.
nina (Recruiter): process note: priority reqs -> post in 3 business days, normal -> up to 10 business days. include two impact metrics on the req.
leah typo (People Ops): (emoji) small correction: internal mobility window opens 7 days after mapping is shared.
leah (People Ops): preview headcount snap:
```
Q1 tactical: +9 (infra 4, runtime 3, reliability 2)
Q2 strategic: +12 (platform 5, enterprise 4, research 3)
Backfills: 7
```
yuri (SWE): can teams request contractors during transitions?
tara (Head of Eng): short-term contractors allowed (<=3 months) for experiments only. long-term ownership needs FT.
kevin (CEO): manager hires limited unless they free up >2x team throughput or are required for compliance. prefer senior ICs.
leah (People Ops): we'll publish the full mapping and an FAQ tomorrow in #all-hands-notes. DM me for private concerns. :wave:
